model: Sage Prime thermal mass flow meter (BACnet MS/TP)
aliases: Sage thermal mass flow meter BACnet
applies_to: Sage Prime thermal mass flow meters ordered with the BACnet MS/TP output.
summary: The Sage Prime is a thermal mass flow meter for gas. The BACnet version talks BACnet MS/TP on its RS-485 terminals and exposes 13 objects: serial number, flow rate, gas temperature and RTD power as inputs, plus analog values for K factor, filtering, low-flow cutoff, full scale, the totalizer and the MS/TP MAC address and baud rate.
notes: The object list has no read/write column. Analog and binary values print a Relinquish Default, so they are shown as commandable; inputs as read-only.
Flow Rate and the flow settings are printed with no-units; the flow unit is set in the meter.
Source: Table 3 'BACnet Object List', page 4 (13 objects).

source.title: Sage Prime BACnet Quick Start Guide

integration.summary: Wire the RS-485 terminals (C1 ground, C2 B+, C3 A-) to the MS/TP trunk, set a unique MAC address and device instance, then read Flow Rate, Temperature and the Totalizer.
setup: Defaults: MAC 49, 9600 baud, device instance 1142049, device name Sage Prime, max master 127, max info frames 1.
Device name and instance are set by writing the Device object properties; changes apply at once.
MAC address (AV 100) and baud rate (AV 101) only apply after a power cycle or writing 1 to Apply Changes (BV 100).
gotchas: Writing 1 to Enable SageCom (BV 101) turns the RS-485 port over to the SageCom tool after a power cycle; BACnet stops until the next power cycle.
If the baud, parity or slave ID used by SageCom were changed from 19200 / Even / 49, the meter drops off MS/TP and falls into SageCom mode about two minutes after power-up.

points.name: Apply Changes
